citation.title: A Novel Topology Optimization Approach using Conditional Deep Learning

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: For a trained CWGAN, generating a planar design takes about 0.35 seconds, compared with roughly 83.9 seconds for SIMP in the reported example.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Section 4, Table 1 and accompanying text: SIMP 83.914 s / CWGAN 0.350 s = 239.8 for the stated example.
claim.alternatives: Table 1 reports several volume-fraction settings; it also reports CWGAN mode collapse and poor results away from volume fraction 0.4.

baseline.implementation: Conventional SIMP algorithm used to generate training data and comparison outputs; code implementation not specified
baseline.problem_size: Planar 2D structure; mesh resolution not stated in comparison table
baseline.classical_time: 83.914 s for the example cited in Section 4; other Table 1 cases range from 71.461 to 114.635 s
baseline.ml_time: 0.350 s for the example cited in Section 4; other Table 1 cases are approximately 0.339–0.353 s
baseline.data_generation_cost: Dataset of 3024 SIMP designs reported (Section 3); generation cost not stated
baseline.quality_metric: Volume fraction and visual/qualitative comparison to SIMP topology
baseline.quality_gap: The generated designs commonly approach volume fraction 0.4 even when other fractions are requested; authors report mode collapse and do not quantify objective/compliance gaps (Section 4, Table 1)

R1.evidence: Section 4/Table 1 compares runtime, but does not establish matched quality; the authors report mode collapse and poor condition-following for several settings.

R2.evidence: The article does not provide evidence that the SIMP implementation or hardware comparison meets an R2 failure criterion.

R3.evidence: The speed claim reports no training time or data-generation cost (Sections 3–4).

R4.evidence: Section 4 evaluates outputs through volume fraction and displayed examples; no FE verification of returned designs or failure-rate accounting is reported.

reporting.n_test_cases: Five volume-fraction settings in Table 1; training set contains 3024 designs
